title: The 2D Euler equations are well-posed for generic initial data in $L^2$
summary: In this note we show the existence of a residual set (in the sense of Baire) of divergence free initial data $u_0\in L^2(D)$, $D=\mathbb{R}^2$ or $\mathbb{T}^2$, for which global existence and uniqueness of weak solutions to the incompressible 2D Euler equations holds. The associated solutions $u$ satisfy the energy balance and are recovered in the vanishing viscosity limit from solutions to 2D Navier-Stokes, which as a consequence cannot display anomalous dissipation of energy.
